blind.description: A stylized village water pump and stone trough. It consists of a low rectangular stone watering basin with carved block borders and a paved floor, and a square wooden post pump situated at one end. The wooden pillar features a pyramidal dark grey iron cap, a curved iron discharge spout pouring over the basin, and a metal pump handle/lever mechanism at the back and side. The model surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and sit flat on the ground without extra display plinths.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular stone basin enclosing a textured stone floor, topped at one end by a square metal post cap with a spout extending inward and a small handle ring protruding from the side.
blind.height_vs_figure: The wooden pump post stands roughly half as tall as the figure (about 3 ft tall), while the stone trough is low (under 1.5 ft tall) and spans approximately 5 to 6 ft in length.
